objective.text: Handle lock-block timeout explicitly instead of assuming protected work always runs.

difficulty.rationale: Handle inability to acquire the lock before assuming the protected callback ran.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

stem: Another owner keeps a cache lock beyond a contender’s block timeout. Which outcome should code around block($seconds, $callback) handle?

options.text: The old owner’s lock is forcibly released and the callback always runs.
options.rationale: Waiting to acquire a lock does not forcibly take ownership from a valid holder.
options.misconception: Waiting to acquire a lock does not forcibly take ownership from a valid holder.

options.text: A LockTimeoutException; the protected callback has not run.
options.rationale: When acquisition cannot complete before the blocking deadline, the helper throws instead of executing unlocked work.

options.text: The callback runs in a queue worker once the timeout expires.
options.rationale: The cache lock API does not implicitly dispatch timed-out work to a queue.
options.misconception: The cache lock API does not implicitly dispatch timed-out work to a queue.

options.text: A null result after executing the callback without the lock.
options.rationale: Timeout does not authorize an unlocked fallback execution of the supplied callback.
options.misconception: Timeout does not authorize an unlocked fallback execution of the supplied callback.
